nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned: reflection balances used as the canonical accounting store for every holder.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 spending approvals, mutated in _approve.
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee: addresses bypassing the team fee, read during _transfer routing decisions.
mapping(address=>bool) bots: blacklist flag checked in _transfer and written by setBots/delBot.
mapping(address=>uint) cooldown: per-recipient timestamp gate used for cooldownEnabled anti-snipe logic.
uint256 _rTotal: total reflection supply, decremented by _reflectFee and used by _getRate.
uint256 _feeAddr1: dynamic tax component (set to 0) consumed by _getValues.
uint256 _feeAddr2: team fee percentage (set to 10) consumed by _getValues/_takeTeam.
address payable _feeAddrWallet1: privileged wallet allowed to call manualswap/manualsend.
address payable _feeAddrWallet2: recipient of ETH in sendETHToFee.
IUniswapV2Router02 uniswapV2Router: router instance set in openTrading and used for swaps/liquidity.
address uniswapV2Pair: LP pair address created in openTrading and used as a routing discriminator in _transfer.
bool tradingOpen: one-shot gate on openTrading.
bool inSwap: reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
bool swapEnabled: enables automatic fee swapping inside _transfer.
bool cooldownEnabled: toggled by setCooldownEnabled and read in _transfer.
uint256 _maxTxAmount: per-transfer cap applied on pair buys.
address _owner: Ownable owner, controls onlyOwner functions and is special-cased in _transfer.
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core routing logic applying fees, cooldown, bot checks and triggering swapTokensForEth/sendETHToFee on sells.
transfer(address,uint256) public: ERC20 entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public: delegates to _transfer then reduces allowance via _approve.
swapTokensForEth(uint256) private lockTheSwap: approves the router and executes an external swap to ETH.
sendETHToFee(uint256) private: pushes contract ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 via a raw transfer.
openTrading() external onlyOwner: wires the router/pair, seeds liquidity via addLiquidityETH and enables swaps.
manualswap() external: privileged manual swap, gated on _msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend() external: privileged manual ETH extraction to the fee wallet.
setBots(address[]) public onlyOwner: blacklists addresses in bulk.
delBot(address) public onlyOwner: removes an address from the blacklist.
setCooldownEnabled(bool) external onlyOwner: toggles the cooldown gate.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address entering through transfer/transferFrom/manualswap/manualsend.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used for cooldown windows and swap deadlines.
External call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens on an attacker-influenced router: value-moving external interaction.
Raw ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2 inside sendETHToFee: unbounded external value call that can invoke receiver code.
External call addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance} during openTrading, forwarding all contract ETH and a deadline.
Parameter 'from' of _transfer, the debited account.
Parameter 'to' of _transfer, the credited account and cooldown key.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer, the token quantity moved.
Parameter 'bots_' array of addresses to blacklist in setBots.
Parameter 'notbot' address removed from the blacklist in delBot.
Parameter 'onoff' boolean written into cooldownEnabled by setCooldownEnabled.
Local 'contractTokenBalance' in _transfer: balanceOf(address(this)) passed to swapTokensForEth.
Local 'contractETHBalance' in _transfer: address(this).balance forwarded to sendETHToFee.
Local 'path' array in swapTokensForEth: [token, WETH] swap route.
Local '_uniswapV2Router' in openTrading: hardcoded router instance assigned to storage.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the 'from' argument of _transfer.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as both the caller and the spender whose allowance is reduced.
manualswap authorization depends solely on the caller-controlled _msgSender() compared with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization depends solely on the caller-controlled _msgSender() compared with _feeAddrWallet1.
openTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares _owner with _msgSender().
The stored _owner value is the sole authority checked by onlyOwner on openTrading.
setBots relies on _owner equality to permit blacklist mutations.
delBot relies on _owner equality to permit blacklist removal.
setCooldownEnabled relies on _owner equality to flip the cooldown gate.
_transfer compares cooldown[to] against block.timestamp, making anti-snipe logic miner-influenceable.
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 seconds, storing a timestamp-derived state value.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Public transfer() unconditionally executes _transfer before returning true.
Public transferFrom() executes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth mid-execution on the sell path, introducing an external interaction before accounting completes.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance, an outbound value call during transfer execution.
_transfer reads and updates the cooldown mapping for the recipient.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee and swap routing.
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to] on the non-owner path.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to distinguish buys and sells.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on cooldown-enabled buys.
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled to decide whether the cooldown branch runs.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before triggering automatic fee conversion.
_transfer reads inSwap to suppress recursive swapping.
_transfer writes _feeAddr1 to configure the fee values consumed by _getValues.
_transfer writes _feeAddr2 to configure the team fee consumed by _getValues.
_transfer ultimately mutates _rOwned balances through _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap without a complete-effects guard beyond inSwap.
The router swap call can re-enter token accounting (e.g. via the pair/fallback path) that writes _rOwned.
sendETHToFee executes a raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet with no reentrancy guard.
ETH transfer can trigger callee code that re-enters _transfer while state has not fully settled.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance.
openTrading writes the hardcoded router instance into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the LP pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true, burning the one-shot guard.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true, activating automatic fee swaps.
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled to true.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the sale cap.
openTrading forwards all contract ETH through addLiquidityETH.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot clears the bots blacklist entry.
setCooldownEnabled writes the caller-supplied boolean into cooldownEnabled.
sendETHToFee forwards ETH to the stored _feeAddrWallet2 destination.
contractTokenBalance is the tokenAmount argument handed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the amount argument handed to sendETHToFee.
The local path array is consumed by swapTokensForEth as the swap route.
The local _uniswapV2Router instance is assigned to the uniswapV2Router storage slot.
Parameter from drives the debit side and all routing conditionals inside _transfer.
Parameter to drives the credit side and cooldown key inside _transfer.
Parameter amount is checked against _maxTxAmount and passed into _tokenTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter has no independent identity outside _transfer and should be folded into the function node it parameterizes.
The to parameter is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer and merges into that core function.
The amount parameter is a transient argument of _transfer and is absorbed by it.
The bots_ array only exists as the input of setBots and should be merged into that function.
The notbot address is exclusively consumed by delBot and merges into that function.
The onoff boolean is exclusively written by setCooldownEnabled and merges into that function.
The temporary balance read is computed solely to feed swapTokensForEth and belongs to that core operation.
The temporary ETH balance is computed solely to feed sendETHToFee and belongs to that core operation.
The swap path array is an ephemeral route consumed only by swapTokensForEth.
The local router instance is created only to populate storage during openTrading and merges into that function.
